other_failure_modes.name: In-sample Target Encoding Leakage
other_failure_modes.description: Target encodings are computed on the training dataset and mapped directly onto the same training data without using out-of-fold (OOF) cross-validation. This introduces severe target leakage, as a row's own target value contributes to its encoded feature, causing tree-based models to heavily overfit.

summary: The agent implements a generally sound modeling pipeline with appropriate data splitting, model selection, and early stopping. However, there is a critical failure mode: the target encoding is performed in-sample without out-of-fold calculation, resulting in severe target leakage. Additionally, the agent uses a naive unweighted ensemble and only evaluates the models once with a single metric.
